name: Multi-Agent-AI-Research-System-with-LangChain
description: Multi-agent AI research system — ReAct agents for search & scraping, LCEL pipelines for writing & self-critique. Built with LangChain, LangGraph, Tavily, and Gemini. Live Streamlit demo included.

paragraphs: A multi-agent AI system that autonomously researches any topic — searching the web, scraping sources for deeper context, drafting a structured report, and critiquing its own output — built with LangChain, LangGraph, and LCEL (Runnables).
🔗 Live Demo: [Add your Streamlit Cloud URL here]

Most "AI chatbot" projects are a single LLM call wrapped in a UI. This project is different: it's a coordinated system of specialized agents, each with its own tools and responsibility, that hand off work to one another to produce a finished, reviewed research report from a single topic query.
features: Two specialized ReAct agents (createagent from LangGraph) — a search agent that queries the web and a reader agent that scrapes and reads full-page content, each restricted to its own tool.
Custom tools built from scratch — websearch (Tavily API) and scrapeurl (BeautifulSoup + requests), both implemented as LangChain @tool-decorated functions rather than pre-built wrappers.

LCEL (LangChain Expression Language) pipelines — the writer and critic stages use pure prompt | llm | outputparser Runnable chains instead of legacy Chain classes, keeping the data flow explicit and composable.
Self-critiquing output — a dedicated critic agent scores the generated report and gives structured, actionable feedback, rather than treating the first draft as final.
Interactive Streamlit UI — a clean web interface for entering a topic and viewing the report, critique, and raw research data in separate tabs, with a Markdown download option.
